acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retained as the closest composite-byte gate, but it does not define the field-level survivor/override set or bind the conditional scope proposal. A repaired proposal must add those checks to its registered tests.
Retained for immutable roles and writer sterility. It does not test whether exposing the PROBE label changes behavior or reveals evaluation membership.

Retained for byte, selection, provenance, identifier, and cross-item noninterference. It does not resolve public role-label leakage, private reader-candidate exposure, or actual-runtime operational channels.

Retained for parser, debit, branch, repeat, diamond, and cycle checks. The bound operation arguments still cannot uniquely construct hypothesis state, and the DREAM/schema publication transition is absent.
Retained for local-atom construction and selected prospective cuts. It does not cross-test typed-agenda laundering or establish dependence on every cited path edge.

Retained for reader isolation and common wire contracts. It does not define the private candidate envelope, conditional rather than realized response equality, or substrate-neutral policy-row provenance.
Retained for matched-dose component and joint-package construction. It does not repair substrate-specific provenance in the common policy adapter.
Retained for baseline interfaces, resource ledgers, and prospective promotion structure. It does not bind the exhaustive contrast-to-metric, direction, threshold, and multiplicity map.
Retained as a scripted distinction between adaptive retrieval and recurrent post-return computation. It does not measure ordinary DREAM context-management value in the full organism.
Retained for deterministic shuffle, twin, cut, split, and replacement-path oracles. Sparse registered cuts do not establish dependence on every decisive path edge.
Retained for independent static no-model sealing. It remains construction evidence and supplies no behavioral or actual-runtime operational result.
Retained for immutable same-lineage construction. It does not add ordinary DREAM participation, cross-check independent-life reset, or bind new/old/cross-era panels to the same checkpoints.

Retained for individual pre-confirmation timing, independent support, contradiction, and target-inertness checks. It lacks an exact DREAM publication transition and a commitment census, multiplicity rule, and stopping exposure.
Retained for Stream/Schema instrument and claim separation. It does not align every developmental checkpoint or prevent lucky-schema selection across an unbounded commitment family.
Retained for deterministic preflight perturbations and missingness handling. It does not register randomized perturbation of the authorized actual model/provider runtime.
Retained for independent recomputation of the stated statistical procedure. It lacks a complete contrast-family map and an exact schema binding all pilot-derived run values and checkpoint alignment.
Retained for disjoint evidence states and fresh-chain enforcement. It cannot cure an unbound authority input or substitute for newly registered tests in a repaired proposal.
Retained as the deliberation gate. The present proposal fails release because the critique identifies unresolved design forks and required tests absent from the proposal registry.
Retained for later transport estimation. Its interpretation remains underbound until private candidate exposure and conditional response serialization are specified.
Retained for later component and substrate effects. Substrate attribution remains invalid until the common policy adapter has provider-neutral, target-blind provenance.
Retained for the registered bypasses, trace checks, and sparse interventions. It cannot support whole-path dependence without edgewise interventions or narrower claim language.

Retained for acquisition, retention, cross-era composition, capacity, and efficiency. Continued-improvement promotion must additionally bind these panels to the same lives and checkpoints as the flywheel estimator.
Retained for the prospective schema execution conjunction. It remains vulnerable to ambiguous schema publication and lucky selection across an unregistered commitment family.

Retained for linked experiential mediation and slope execution. As written it identifies a memory-action flywheel without ordinary DREAM causality and can hide forgetting unless conjunctively linked to T22.
Retained as the later review and authority gate. It cannot repair missing proposal-level tests, bind an unreviewed scope proposal, or convert this rework consensus into implementation authority.
Retained for final recomputation and literal claim release. An omnibus audit cannot retroactively create missing estimands, interventions, reset tests, or prospective statistical registrations.

agreements: PPC4 materially improves the causal separation of recurrent THINK, provisional DREAM, evidence-gated SLEEP, reader transport, matched-dose component packages, and policy-matched substrate comparisons.
Only closed ACQUISITION and MEDIATION_ACQUIRE roots may write; PROBE outcomes must remain sterile and reporting-only.

Hidden truth, scorer outputs, target membership and order, privileged generator semantics, and completed probe results cannot enter cognition, DREAM, SLEEP targets, treatment selection, or same-claim redesign.
Construction fixtures, static sealers, interface tests, scripted rehearsals, and design review establish contracts or sensitivity, not behavioral effects or scientific claims.

PCFL-Stream cannot support compression language; dreamed learned lossy compression requires the separate prospective schema rung and all of its temporal, causal, utility, detail, substrate, and numeric gates.
Reader-only LoRA must never mount in THINK or ACT, and substrate comparisons require the same frozen DECIDE+ACT policy and exact public READ contract.

Pathway credit requires prospective authentic paths, strong bypasses, recurrence and adaptivity ablations, actual trace evidence, and causal interventions; correct answers or citations alone are insufficient.
The developmental flywheel requires immutable within-lineage links from memory through epistemic action, observation, writer admission, remount, later path, and later action across independent lives.
Continued improvement cannot be inferred from an aggregate positive slope while old knowledge is forgotten or cross-era composition fails.
The critique identifies required tests absent from the proposal registry. Consensus cannot add them, so the exact PPC4 bytes require rework and a fresh hash-bound deliberation chain.
No present artifact authorizes implementation, model calls, training, canaries, GPU work, parenting, evaluation-label changes, or scientific claims.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. File ordering and hashes do not mechanically identify surviving graph, loop, claim, test, and human-boundary entries.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a field-level precedence and survivor manifest that explicitly resolves every inherited registry and authority clause, including whether the v4 acceptance-test registry replaces all earlier registries; register a dedicated mutation test in a repaired proposal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. A later canonical scope_proposal.json can change ratification scope without changing any reviewed artifact hash.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Hash-bind the exact scope proposal as reviewed authority input or bind and test its required absence so later file creation cannot affect this change; register the authority-dependency test in a repaired proposal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Identifier-only HYPOTHESIZE and REVISE arguments do not uniquely determine hypothesis content, status, citations, or replacement state.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind an executable least-privilege transition schema that deterministically creates and revises every hypothesis field, then register same-input/same-next-state goldens covering creation, contradiction, replacement, and branch closure.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. A persistent pre-confirmation commitment cannot be reconstructed from the current non-durable workspace-replacement semantics.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the exact DREAM response union and state transition for one append-only, provisional, non-evidentiary schema event; specify its relationship to the single workspace replacement, revisions, persistence, later support, and SLEEP eligibility, with dedicated transition goldens in a repaired proposal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Typed relation, prediction, and action identifiers can be target-sufficient, and later abandonment or contradiction is not cross-tested against writer admission.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind retroactive admission semantics for abandoned, contradicted, failed, and superseded transitions and register adversarial cross-product fixtures showing that answer-bearing typed agendas cannot enter positive rows through any branch.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. The public PROBE label exposes confirmatory-regime membership even while manifest membership is declared forbidden.
concern_dispositions.required_change: A repaired proposal must choose either harness-private writer roles or prospectively matched public roles with an explicit role-label behavioral ablation and interaction test; the current bytes cannot choose between these materially different interfaces.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Ordered citation plus bridge, binding, and null interventions establishes selected dependence, not use of every edge.
concern_dispositions.required_change: A repaired proposal must either add prospective leave-one-edge-out or binding-twin dependence tests for every decisive edge or narrow the claim to dependence on the specifically intervened bridge and binding records.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Equal realized responses would erase the transport contrast, while unmatched candidate exposure changes recognition into generation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a private provider envelope specifying candidate strings or index state, order, candidate work, tokenizer, failures, and normalization; define equality as interface and conditional serialization equality rather than equal realized retrieval outcomes, and register paired tests in a repaired proposal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. One adapter hash across cells does not prevent its training traces from privileging one reader substrate.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a target-blind provider-neutral or prospectively counterbalanced policy-row origin whose causal prefixes, return distributions, serializer, and exposure are independent of the evaluated substrate; register provenance and counterfactual invariance tests.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. T24 can pass for a THINK-SLEEP memory-action loop and does not identify ordinary DREAM context-management value.
concern_dispositions.required_change: A repaired proposal must either narrow the claim to an experiential memory-action flywheel or add a same-lineage, equal-budget requested-DREAM versus no-DREAM or deterministic-truncation intervention with a separately registered execution gate.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. A favorable aggregate slope may represent turnover, and the current cycle/checkpoint counts do not define one alignment.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make continued-improvement promotion conjunctively require new acquisition, old retention, and cross-era composition on the same lives, mediation lineages, sleeps, and checkpoints; bind a one-to-one cycle/sleep/checkpoint/panel map and slope vector in a repaired proposal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Generic Holm, interval, and effect rules do not make every conjunct machine-checkable.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind an exhaustive prospective table mapping every transport, component, substrate, bypass, path, schema, mediation, and longitudinal contrast to its metric, direction, superiority or equivalence rule, threshold, ceiling, multiplicity family, and promotion consequence; register completeness validation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. The pilot-derived life count, extension, equivalence, and missingness values affect validity but have no exact named binding schema or change semantics.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define the later hash-bound numeric/run artifact, including pilot hash and disjointness, calculation inputs, life count, maximum extension, equivalence margin, missingness threshold, and checkpoint map; any value change must require fresh review and exact human run authority.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as blocking. Individual prospective timestamps do not control template spraying, favorable stopping, or selective retention.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Predeclare the schema-commitment census or cap, hypothesis families, failed-commitment denominator, contradiction-exposure schedule, SLEEP stopping boundary, and multiplicity or selective-inference rule; register adversarial lucky-selection fixtures and execution gates.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Deterministic preflight stubs cannot establish noninterference of the actual model/provider runtime.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Register a later-authorized randomized operational perturbation execution covering cache, batching, latency, provider faults, candidate work, timeout, process state, publication, output, and condition-specific survival, with a prospective estimand and invalidation rule.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted as material. Independent-life inference depends on a comprehensive reset whose survival from PPC3 is itself ambiguous.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Register an explicit two-life cold-reset test covering adapters, corpora, workspaces, ledgers, stores, indices, caches, RNG streams, identifiers, environment/process state, and outputs, with mutation fixtures proving no cross-life effect.

disagreements.issue: Whether total file order plus later-conflict override defines the complete normative survivor set, or whether every inherited field and registry requires an explicit disposition.

positions.position: Treat later explicit conflicts as overrides and retain all other earlier clauses by interpretation.
Require a machine-readable survivor, replacement, and override disposition for every inherited graph, loop, claim, visibility, test, and human-boundary entry.

resolution.rationale: Conflict recognition is itself interpretive, and the current intake checks only the v4 registry. Exact composite execution requires field-level resolution.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the field-level-manifest position in a newly hash-bound proposal and register a test that mutates every survivor and precedence edge.

disagreements.issue: Whether an optional canonical scope_proposal.json may affect later ratification without being part of the reviewed architecture chain.

positions.position: Permit the intake to adopt a canonical scope proposal whenever that file exists at ratification time.
Require the exact scope proposal to be hash-bound in the reviewed chain or prove and test that it is absent and non-normative.

resolution.rationale: Authority cannot depend on bytes that can appear after consensus without changing any upstream hash.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the bound-authority-input position and register creation, mutation, and absence fixtures in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether identifier-only operation arguments are sufficient to construct deterministic hypothesis state.

positions.position: Let the implementation infer hypothesis content and status from cited records after accepting the identifier-only operation.
Bind least-privilege typed fields or a deterministic derivation function that uniquely produces all hypothesis and revision bytes.

resolution.rationale: Parser determinism does not imply deterministic next state when content, status, citations, and replacement relations are unspecified.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the bound-transition position and register same-operation transition goldens in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether DREAM's non-durable workspace replacement can create the persistent declarative commitment required by PCFL-Schema.

positions.position: Treat the schema as part of the temporary replacement workspace and infer its later persistence from audit history.
Permit one append-only provisional schema event within DREAM publication while reserving parametric publication and training eligibility for SLEEP.

resolution.rationale: Temporal direction requires immutable declarative persistence, but that persistence need not be parametric durability or evidence.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the append-only-declarative position and bind the exact response union, state transition, revision rules, and support lifecycle in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether typed operation targets are safe merely because they contain no free text, including when their branch is later abandoned or contradicted.

positions.position: Admit committed typed enums and public identifiers because their syntax is least-privilege and causally prefixed.
Also test target sufficiency and retroactively exclude abandoned, contradicted, superseded, failed, or answer-bearing typed transitions.

resolution.rationale: Typed identifiers can encode an agenda or final decision, and later lifecycle changes can invalidate their eligibility.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the semantic-lifecycle position and register the missing typed-agenda-by-branch cross-product test in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether cognition should see ACQUISITION versus PROBE or whether writer role should remain harness-private.

positions.position: Expose the immutable role so the model can follow distinct acquisition and probe instructions, provided comparisons use the same label.
Keep writer eligibility and evaluation membership harness-private because the model does not need them to act.
Expose a matched public role only if a prospective role-label ablation shows no benchmark-specific strategy or treatment interaction.

resolution.rationale: All positions preserve mechanical sterility but produce materially different model-visible interfaces. The current evidence does not choose among them.
resolution.required_change: A newly hash-bound proposal must select private roles or define matched public exposure plus a registered behavioral role-label ablation before target execution.

disagreements.issue: Whether authentic ordered citation plus selected bridge, binding, and null cuts proves use of every edge in the presealed path.

positions.position: Treat full ordered citation and sensitivity to the registered sparse interventions as evidence that the complete path was used.
Require prospective leave-one-edge-out or equivalent binding-twin dependence for every decisive edge.
Retain sparse interventions but narrow the claim to dependence on the specifically intervened bridge and binding records.

resolution.rationale: Citation can be ceremonial. Both edgewise testing and narrower language are defensible, but they support different claims and costs.
resolution.required_change: A repaired proposal must choose edgewise dependence testing or narrowed selected-record dependence and register the chosen gate prospectively.

disagreements.issue: How candidate domains are privately supplied to TEXT, GRAPH, and reader-LoRA providers and what response-byte equality means.

positions.position: Require the realized FOUND or NOT_FOUND record bytes to match across providers.
Require identical public schemas, candidate domains, ordering, tokenizer, work budgets, and conditional serialization while allowing realized retrieval outcomes to differ.
Withhold candidate strings from reader-LoRA and compare its generation/search behavior against indexed text and graph readers.

resolution.rationale: Realized equality collapses the transport estimand, while generation versus recognition changes the task. Conditional equality is necessary, but the exact private candidate representation remains a material design choice.
resolution.required_change: Adopt conditional wire equality, then bind one matched private candidate-domain representation and candidate-work contract in a repaired proposal with paired interface tests.

disagreements.issue: Whether mounting one common policy adapter is sufficient when its training rows may originate from one substrate's retrieval traces.

positions.position: Treat identical policy-adapter bytes across substrate cells as sufficient policy matching.
Require target-blind provider-neutral or prospectively counterbalanced READ returns in the common policy training manifest.

resolution.rationale: A common hash controls mounting but not the retrieval distribution encoded during training.
resolution.required_change: Adopt provider-neutral provenance and register row-origin, counterbalancing, and counterfactual-invariance checks in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether a linked memory-action chain without an ordinary DREAM intervention may be called the full THINK-DREAM-SLEEP organism.

positions.position: Call the linked chain a full flywheel because DREAM opportunities exist and schema-specific DREAM is tested separately.
Describe T24 only as an experiential memory-action flywheel with no ordinary DREAM attribution.
Require equal-budget requested-DREAM versus no-DREAM or deterministic-truncation intervention within the same mediation lineage.

resolution.rationale: The current chain cannot establish ordinary context-management value. Narrowing the claim and adding a DREAM intervention are both coherent but materially different.
resolution.required_change: A repaired proposal must select narrow memory-action language or register a causal ordinary-DREAM context-value execution test and integrate it into full-flywheel promotion.

disagreements.issue: Whether a favorable mediated treatment slope alone establishes continued developmental improvement.

positions.position: Use the preregistered aggregate treatment-versus-baseline slope once the same-lineage mediation chain passes.
Require new acquisition, old retention, and cross-era composition to pass on the same lives and aligned checkpoints, alongside mediation and slope rules.

resolution.rationale: An aggregate slope can rise by replacing old knowledge with recent knowledge. Continued development requires simultaneous acquisition, retention, and cross-era value.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the conjunctive-panel position and bind the exact cycle, sleep, checkpoint, panel, and two-interval alignment in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether generic statistical rules are enough or every claim contrast must be assigned prospectively to a metric and multiplicity family.

positions.position: Apply Holm, simultaneous intervals, and the 0.35 threshold to whichever co-primary contrasts the later manifest identifies.
Bind every contrast's metric, direction, threshold, superiority or equivalence rule, family, ceiling, and promotion effect before targets open.

resolution.rationale: Without an exhaustive map, endpoints and multiplicity families can be chosen after outcomes while still invoking the generic procedure.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the exhaustive-mapping position and register a completeness validator in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether PPC4 already binds exact numeric rules when several validity and promotion values remain pilot-derived.

positions.position: Treat the stated procedure and minimum thresholds as exact enough, with remaining numbers filled by later review.
Describe PPC4 as binding the procedure and minima, then require a named hash-bound run artifact for every pilot-derived value and its change semantics.

resolution.rationale: Deferral from an untouched pilot is prospectively sound only if the later inputs, calculations, values, and authority are exact and immutable before targets.
resolution.required_change: Adopt two-stage binding and define the exact later artifact, pilot disjointness, calculations, value inventory, and fresh-approval rule in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether individually prospective schema commitments suffice without controlling the number of commitments and contradiction exposure.

positions.position: Evaluate each commitment independently using timing, two supports, zero contradictions, and downstream utility.
Predeclare the commitment census or cap, family, denominator, contradiction schedule, stopping boundary, and multiplicity or selective-inference rule.

resolution.rationale: A system can spray many schemas and retain lucky confirmations while every retained schema individually passes.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the familywise-commitment position and register lucky-spraying and favorable-stopping fixtures plus the corresponding execution gate in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether deterministic preflight perturbations plus observational postrun audit establish operational noninterference.

positions.position: Use deterministic paired fixtures before execution and inspect actual resources and missingness afterward.
Prospectively randomize operational perturbations during later authorized model/provider execution and estimate their effects on output and survival.

resolution.rationale: Preflight establishes contract behavior, while observational audit cannot identify causal runtime sensitivity.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the authorized-runtime-intervention position and add a separately registered later execution test in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether inherited PPC3 reset prose and omnibus execution/audit are sufficient for independent-life inference under the ambiguous composite registry.

positions.position: Rely on the nonconflicting PPC3 reset clause and verify independence during T24 and T26.
Register a comprehensive two-life cold-reset invariant in the current successor registry.

resolution.rationale: The sampling unit depends on reset, and composite ambiguity prevents relying on an inherited test whose registry status is unknown.
resolution.required_change: Adopt the explicit-reset position and register mutation-based two-life cold-reset coverage in a repaired proposal.

questions: Do you direct preparation of a newly hash-bound successor that incorporates every accepted repair and registers all missing tests, without treating this consensus as ratification?

For public roles and pathway evidence, should the successor keep writer roles harness-private and narrow claims to selected-record dependence, or expose roles and claim whole-path use only with the corresponding behavioral ablations and edgewise interventions?

Should the full-flywheel claim be narrowed to experiential memory-action learning, or should the successor add an ordinary DREAM context-management intervention; and what matched private candidate representation should define the reader assay?

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. A total file order does not mechanically disposition inherited registries or human-boundary clauses.
Accepted. The operation schema lacks sufficient bytes or a deterministic derivation rule for unique hypothesis mutation.
Accepted. Declarative persistence must be distinguished explicitly from forbidden parametric durability.
Accepted. PPC4 binds procedures and some minima, not all pilot-derived run numbers; a later exact artifact is required.
The diagnosis is accepted, but the material choice between narrower memory-action language and an added causal DREAM intervention remains unresolved.
The diagnosis is accepted, but the choice between edgewise dependence tests and a narrower selected-record claim remains unresolved.
Accepted. Continued-improvement promotion must conjunctively require new, old, and cross-era panels on the same aligned lives and checkpoints.
